De Wet Deregulering Beoordeling Arbeidsr: The Wet Deregulering Beoordeling Arbeidsrelaties (Wet DBA) determines how the Tax Authority assesses whether you as a self-employed person truly work independently, or whether there is actually a case of an employment relationship. That is called false self-employment. Since January 1, 2025, the Tax Authority actively enforces the Wet DBA. Both clients and contractors may therefore face back taxes and fines.

The Tax Authority looks at the actual situation when making its assessment, not just what is stated on paper.
